description.plain:
The NAXOS BLACK LEATHER slip-on loafer combines timeless style with durable design, featuring a signature horsebit hardware decal for a refined touch. Its lug sole offers enhanced traction and stability, making it a versatile choice for both professional and casual settings. Crafted from premium materials, this loafer ensures lasting comfort and sophistication.

  • 1.5 inch heel height
  • Leather upper material
  • Textile and synthetic lining
  • Textile and synthetic sock
  • Synthetic sole
  • Imported
